title: Keep dependency validation and registered replay consistent
head: aadb2145b41a9d72ddbc6dc0f68c7b0912ebced3
body:
Metadata validation treats an omitted requirements list as empty, but replay indexes the absent key and raises KeyError before executing a valid package. Validation also accepts two exact versions of the same distribution, an environment contract that cannot be satisfied.

Normalize the accepted empty default in the in-memory validated manifest and reject conflicting per-distribution pins. Contributor manifest bytes are not rewritten. Existing exact-version installation/checking and child failure propagation stay in place.

Validation: before the fix, omitted lists raise KeyError with and without installation enabled, and both conflicting-version controls are accepted. Afterward, generated pinned-package fixtures replay successfully with omitted/empty lists in both install modes; failing children still reject. Distinct-distribution pins remain accepted. Required research tooling suite passes 67 tests with 3 pre-existing Linux-only skips on Windows CPython 3.12.14. All 450 current ready manifests were scanned; none has conflicting per-distribution pins. git diff --check passes. No full mathematical replay or dependency installation was performed.

Task selection: recursive-interfaces seed 60fc06b8f8417be93f0978cec9e0f702, changed to a concrete replay-contract defect. Current canonical main 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority revision 4; complete PR/Discussion/local-note overlap checked. Credit Douglas Colkitt and retained research-package runner contributors. New work by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0. No frozen scientific evidence or selected frontier changes.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
